agreements: v2 prediction: solid white for the whole clip, as captured
v2 SDK text: inverting composite, empty canvas shown white, light pale screen

misses.observed: dim grey web of strokes vs solid white
misses.cause: the warp divides by a canvas sample (mscale = 1/tex2D(sampler_pw_main,(q20,.004)).z with q20 unset); projectM clears the canvas at load, so 1/0 = inf and the compound i*=mscale gives NaN, stored as 0: black is absorbing and the inverting composite shows white. The illustrator started from the flat-field state (white) and refused the non-finite division, so both shaders fell back
misses.fix: the canvas starts cleared when the history covers the time since load; illustration stages use IEEE semantics (gles300-ieee-illustration-v1) and store NaN as 0
